I own all the yellows, but building seems unavailable right now, possibly restricted to a pre-roll phase. Houses would run $150 each and I've only got $147 on hand, though mortgaging Pacific, Illinois, and Baltic could free up $447—still, doing that now without being able to build just eats into rent income for no benefit, so I'm weighing whether to hold off until a build phase opens up.

With only 15 houses left in the bank, the housing shortage is a real factor, and I'm nervous about landing on p1's Boardwalk or p4's light blues soon—I'm at Pennsylvania, so Park Place and Boardwalk are both coming up, and I couldn't survive a hit with houses on Boardwalk. Instead of mortgaging, I'm considering trading Illinois to p2 for roughly $260 cash, which would help me build next turn while only nudging p2 closer to red (still blocked by p1 on that monopoly anyway).
